title: m3mento
tagline: m3mento is a decentralized marketplace using Celo and Nouns to facilitate the purchase of feminine health products and beyond, emphasizing kindness and blockchain-powered generosity.
description:
m3mento leverages the decentralized, secure, and efficient capabilities of blockchain technology to create a unique marketplace focused on combating period poverty through the availability of feminine health products. At its core, m3mento is powered by the Celo blockchain, known for its global accessibility, low fees, and eco-friendly design, making it an ideal platform for microtransactions necessary for purchasing these products. Integration with Nouns further enriches m3mento's community-driven aspect, utilizing Nouns' DAO structure for governance and funding of communal projects, with the plan that a portion of every transaction supports initiatives aimed at enhancing menstrual health education and accessibility.

The platform is designed to be inclusive, providing a seamless user experience that allows anyone to participate, whether by listing products, purchasing items for themselves, or gifting them to others, all within a cryptocurrency-based ecosystem. By harnessing the power of Celo and Nouns, m3mento not only facilitates transactions but also fosters a community committed to making a difference in the world of feminine health, all underpinned by the principles of kindness and blockchain-powered generosity.
how_its_made:
m3mento is built on a tech stack that prioritizes speed, security, and user accessibility. The backbone of the project is the Celo blockchain, chosen for its alignment with the project's goals of inclusivity and environmental responsibility. Smart contracts for marketplace transactions are deployed on Celo, handling listings, purchases, and transfers with minimal fees.

The frontend and user interface is developed using React, ensuring a responsive, intuitive experience across devices. The integration with MiniPay, a mobile, stablecoin-based, non-custodial wallet built out by Opera on Celo, allows for seamless transactions directly in the app, enhancing user convenience and payments security.

To foster community engagement and governance, m3mento utilizes Nouns' DAO assets. This integration enables project participants to vote on key decisions, manage funding for menstrual health initiatives, and contribute to the project's direction, embodying the decentralized ethos of web3.
